glosses: at most, at the most; as much as possible; to the maximum

examples.en: We have to do our best.
Please be as brief as possible.

examples.text: Мы должны максимально воспользоваться этой ситуацией.
examples.en: We have to make the most of this situation.

examples.text: Том и Мэри сидели на диване максимально далеко друг от друга.
examples.en: Tom and Mary were sitting on the sofa as far away from each other as possible.
